chunks: The call and the tathwib in the adhan are from the sunnah (prophetic tradition).
As for what Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Husayn, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Shu'ayb ibn Ya'qub, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: Abi Basir, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abi 'Abd Allah, Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.التَّثْوِيبُ: tathwib, a formula or repeated call associated with the adhan
key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the sunnah, the normative prophetic tradition
key_terms.النِّدَاءُ: the call, referring here to the liturgical call associated with prayer
key_terms.الْأَذَانِ: the adhan, the ritual call to prayer

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Istibsar say about the call and tathwib in the adhan?
ai.summary: This report heading concerns the issue of the call and tathwib in the adhan within the framework of sunnah (prophetic tradition). The provided text consists of the topic heading and the sanad/isnad leading to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام, indicating a hadith related to rulings of the adhan and iqamah.
